metadata.methods_description: Normal-hearing young adults listened to audiobook-based multiband peaky speech (dichotic, audiological bands) in a sound-isolating booth at about 65 dB SPL via ER-2 insert earphones, while EEG was recorded with BrainVision. Stimuli were presented in 10 s trials using custom expyfun Python scripts. Trials of different conditions were randomly interleaved, and triggers encoded condition, trial number and stimulus file.
